sources.title: Minimal gauge inflation and the refined Swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Determine whether minimal gauge inflation can obey the refined de Sitter disjunction across its selected field branch and fit the quoted CMB inputs, thereby restricting the unknown universal constants c1 and c2.

sources.title: Type I Hilltop Inflation and the Refined Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Can a small field hilltop model fit CMB observables and satisfy the refined de Sitter conjecture? The comparison concerns conventional slow-roll dynamics and modified dynamics on a brane, while keeping potential curvature distinct from the dynamical slow-roll parameter.

sources.title: Higgs Inflation and the Refined dS Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the Higgs act as the inflaton while its potential satisfies the refined de Sitter conjecture throughout the field interval needed for inflation? The paper asks which conjecture constants permit this and whether observations exclude that region.

sources.title: Reheating constraints on the inflaton and dark matter: Swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Can varying the shape scale of a supergravity-inspired plateau maintain observational agreement while bringing the conjecture parameters toward order unity?

sources.title: Primordial black hole tower: Dark matter, earth-mass, and LIGO black holes

evidence.text: Can positive-potential inflation satisfy the field-space restrictions conjectured for effective theories admitting quantum-gravity completion?

sources.title: Inflation, swampland and landscape

evidence.text: Can string-inspired tip inflation satisfy the alternative gradient and curvature conditions of the refined de Sitter conjecture, and which parameter regions do the authors identify as compatible with inflationary observations?

sources.title: Higgs inflation and its extensions and the further refining dS swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Can metric Higgs inflation, Palatini Higgs inflation, and Higgs–Dilaton inflation satisfy the further-refined de Sitter conjecture through suitable choices of its parameters, despite reported tension with the earlier refined conjecture?

sources.title: Palatini Higgs inflation and the refined dS conjecture

evidence.text: Can the positive inflationary plateau of Palatini Higgs inflation satisfy either branch of the refined de Sitter conjecture with positive order-one constants, while remaining compatible with the quoted cosmological constraints and its assumed inflationary regime?

sources.title: Scalar Weak Gravity Conjecture in Super Yang-Mills Inflationary Model

evidence.text: Which field regions of four composite inflation potentials satisfy both scalar weak-gravity inequalities, alongside previously reported further-refined de Sitter compatibility?

sources.title: Minimal gauge inflation and the refined Swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Use the spectral tilt to infer the inverse decay scale, eliminate the e-fold exponential through the tensor ratio, and solve for the amplitude and e-fold count. The procedure propagates rather than independently checks its input approximations.

sources.title: Type I Hilltop Inflation and the Refined Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Agent reconstruction matches coefficients in the supplied equations and redefines the curvature and endpoint variables together. sources.title: Gauss–Bonnet Inflation and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Integrate the reconstructed field flow from a specified endpoint, invert for the horizon-exit field, and evaluate excursion and observables consistently. Retain endpoint assumptions and use independent formula representations to expose normalization or transcription conflicts.

sources.title: Higgs Inflation and the Refined dS Conjecture

evidence.text: Find the field subsets satisfying each branch, compare their endpoints, and convert overlap and endpoint conditions into parameter inequalities. The paper applies this operation to the Higgs potential's decreasing slope ratio and nonmonotonic curvature ratio.

sources.title: Modular Inflation at Higher Level $N$

evidence.text: Use the modular derivative zero to guide an initial-condition scan, integrate backgrounds, and vary μ to meet CMB comparison cuts and 50–70 e-folds.

sources.title: Reheating constraints on the inflaton and dark matter: Swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Map an inflationary solution to a reheating history by matching the pivot scale to today's thermal scale. Impose nonnegative duration and a completion-temperature floor within the constant-equation-of-state approximation.

sources.title: How accidental was inflation?

evidence.text: How sensitively do supergravity inflation models depend on relative couplings, and can small departures from their Starobinsky or new-inflation limits improve CMB agreement while alleviating large-field initial-condition problems? The focus is potential-flatness tuning rather than the overall inflationary hierarchy.

sources.title: Palatini Higgs inflation and the refined dS conjecture

evidence.text: The setting isolates how an independently varied gravitational connection changes the canonical Higgs inflation potential and its refined-dS diagnostics. The analysis keeps a single scalar and freezes the non-minimal coupling xi.

sources.title: S-dual inflation and the string swampland

evidence.text: Can reflection-symmetric single-field inflation satisfy CMB constraints and proposed quantum-gravity restrictions simultaneously? Does replacing potential endpoints with exact dynamical endpoints materially change that assessment?

sources.title: Two-Field quintessential Higgs Inflation

evidence.text: The model asks whether a nonminimally coupled Higgs can drive inflation while an exponentially coupled second scalar remains available for late dark energy.

sources.title: On $S$-Matrix Exclusion of de Sitter and Naturalness

evidence.text: What would the claimed exclusion of de Sitter vacua and eternal inflation by an S-matrix formulation of quantum gravity imply for Higgs-mass selection mechanisms, and could the weak–Planck hierarchy itself follow from S-matrix consistency?

sources.title: Non-Minimal M-flation
